comment: Shared fixture for financial_report_extractions.document_meta (docs/plans/fundamentals-coverage.md 2.5). The Python extractor derives each case's expected object from its text with deterministic regexes; the Go test (services/pkg/extractiontrust) asserts every expected object is inside the closed vocabulary and that each invalid input loses exactly its bad keys. An absent key means absent: never guess.
rules: currency: from a presentation statement '(presented|expressed|reported|stated) in <US|United States|Australian|New Zealand|Canadian> dollars' -> USD|AUD|NZD|CAD; the evidence is that phrase verbatim. With no such statement, a currency-prefixed unit header (US$, A$, NZ$, C$ before million/billion/'000/m/bn) sets it, with that header as the evidence. Two distinct currencies at the winning level -> currency omitted. A bare '$' never sets a currency.

units: unit statements are '<prefix>$ Million', '$m', '$M', '$ million', '(A$ million)', '$bn', '$ billion', '$'000', '$000', 'thousands of', 'nearest dollar' / 'whole dollars' (-> units). Exactly one distinct unit value across the pages read -> that value, the first statement verbatim as the evidence; several distinct values -> units and units_evidence omitted. A figure such as '$412.6m' is not a unit statement.
entity: the value of a 'Name of entity' line; else the name immediately before 'ABN' on the same line; else omitted.
abn: 'ABN' then 11 digits grouped 2-3-3-3, emitted as 'NN NNN NNN NNN', only when the ABN checksum passes.
period_end / period_type: the first '(half-year|half year|six months|year|financial year) ended <d Month yyyy>'; half-year and six months -> half, year -> annual. 'as at <date>' is not a period end.

report_kind: first match in this order anywhere in the pages read: 'Appendix 4E' -> appendix_4e, 'Appendix 4D' -> appendix_4d, 'Annual Report' -> annual_report, 'half-year report' / 'half year report' / 'half-year financial report' / 'interim financial report' -> half_year_report, 'results announcement' / 'profit announcement' / 'results for announcement to the market' -> results_announcement; then, in the document's head only (its first five non-empty lines, each starting within the first 400 characters): when a head line that reads as a heading (not a sentence) names the document a presentation ('Investor Presentation', 'FY26 Results Presentation'), a Pillar 3 disclosure, a transcript or a webcast -> other; else 'results release' / 'full year results' / 'half year results' (not followed by presentation, briefing, webcast, call or transcript) -> results_announcement; else omitted, and the title decides. 'presentation currency', 'basis of presentation' and a sentence announcing a presentation or webcast never make a document 'other'.
